airspace.zh: 法國規定：不得飛越歷史古蹟、自然保護區與國家公園，也不得在城鎮的公共空間上空飛行；高度上限120公尺，禁止夜間飛行；C1到C4級、以及有相機的C0級無人機都要向法國民航總局DGAC登記，每次起飛前請先查官方Géoportail限飛地圖。聖米歇爾山本身就是歷史古蹟。實際飛行前請先確認最新規定。
airspace.en: French rules: no flying over historic monuments, nature reserves or national parks, or over public space in built-up areas; 120 m maximum height and no night flying; C1–C4 drones, and C0 drones with a camera, must be registered with the DGAC, and the official Géoportail restriction map should be checked before every flight. Mont-Saint-Michel itself is a historic monument. Check the current rules before any real flight.

tombelaine.note: Granite islet north of the mount (N 48°39.600 W 1°30.767)

tagline.zh-Hant: 708年的異象、諾曼人的修道院、百年戰爭的圍城、監獄歲月，到1979年的世界遺產
tagline.en: A vision in 708, a Norman abbey, Hundred Years' War sieges, a prison, and World Heritage in 1979

zh: 這裡是法國諾曼第的聖米歇爾山，
離海岸大約一公里的潮汐島。
en: This is Mont-Saint-Michel in Normandy, France,
a tidal island about a kilometre off the coast.

zh: 它原本叫做「通布山」；
相傳708年，大天使米迦勒向一位主教顯現。
en: It was once called Mont Tombe;
legend says that in 708 the Archangel Michael appeared to a bishop.

zh: 他是阿夫朗什的主教奧貝爾，
大天使要他在山上蓋一座小禮拜堂。
en: He was Aubert, Bishop of Avranches,
and the archangel asked him to build an oratory on the mount.

zh: 傳說他到第三晚才照做，大天使用手指按出了凹痕；
那顆頭骨，今天還收藏在阿夫朗什的聖熱爾韋大教堂。
en: The story says he acted only on the third night, after Michael pressed a finger into his skull;
the dented skull is kept in the Saint-Gervais basilica in Avranches.

zh: 867年的貢比涅條約，把這裡交給布列塔尼人；
933年，它才確定成為諾曼第的一部分。
en: The Treaty of Compiègne of 867 gave the mount to the Bretons;
in 933 it became Norman for good.

zh: 貝葉掛毯的第16、17景，
畫到了這座山，和附近的流沙。
en: Scenes 16 and 17 of the Bayeux Tapestry
show the mount and the quicksand nearby.

zh: 966年，本篤會修士來到山上；
十一世紀，沃爾皮亞諾的威廉，在四座地下室上蓋起教堂。
en: In 966 Benedictine monks settled on the mount;
in the 11th century William of Volpiano raised a church on four crypts.

zh: 1204年一場大火之後，法王腓力二世出資重建；
十三世紀，蓋起了哥德式的「奇蹟樓」。
en: After a fire in 1204, King Philip Augustus paid for rebuilding;
in the 13th century the Gothic Merveille was built.

zh: 百年戰爭時，英軍在1423年進駐北邊的通布蘭島，
把它當成圍攻聖米歇爾山的基地。
en: In the Hundred Years' War the English took the islet of Tombelaine in 1423
and used it as a base against the mount.

zh: 1434年6月17日，英軍丟下了攻城的大砲。
en: The sieges of 1423–24 and 1433–34 both failed;
on 17 June 1434 the English abandoned their bombards.

zh: 法國大革命之後，修道院變成監獄，一直到1863年，
大約關過一萬四千人。
en: After the French Revolution the abbey became a prison until 1863,
holding about 14,000 prisoners.

zh: 作家雨果從1836年起，為它奔走；
1874年，聖米歇爾山列為歷史古蹟，開始修復。
en: From 1836 the writer Victor Hugo campaigned for it;
in 1874 it became a historic monument and restoration began.

zh: 1879年，一條堤道把山和陸地連起來；
1901到1938年，還有電車開到山腳。
en: In 1879 a causeway joined the mount to the mainland;
from 1901 to 1938 a tramway ran out to its foot.

zh: 1944年7月31日，巴頓將軍的部隊抵達阿夫朗什，
帶來了著名的「阿夫朗什突破」。
en: On 31 July 1944 General Patton's troops reached Avranches,
leading to the Avranches Breakthrough.

zh: 1966年，修道院慶祝建立一千年；
1979年，聖米歇爾山和它的海灣，列入世界遺產。
en: In 1966 the abbey marked its thousandth year;
in 1979 Mont-Saint-Michel and its bay became World Heritage.

tagline.zh-Hant: 二十三位居民與每年兩百五十萬訪客、雨果的奔走、阿夫朗什的手抄本，與鹽沼上的羊
tagline.en: 23 residents and 2.5 million visitors a year, manuscripts in Avranches, and sheep on the salt marshes

zh: 山上的居民，2023年只有二十三人；
每年來訪的遊客，卻有大約兩百五十萬人。
en: In 2023 just 23 people lived on the mount,
yet about 2.5 million visitors come every year.

zh: 山上有六十多處受保護的建築，
還有五十家商店、四座博物館和一百三十二間客房。
en: The mount has more than sixty protected buildings,
along with 50 shops, four museums and 132 hotel rooms.

zh: 1979年列入世界遺產時，它因為景觀之美，
和在基督教傳統裡的地位而受到肯定。
en: When it was listed in 1979 it was recognised for its beauty
and its importance to the Christian tradition.

zh: 2007年，世界遺產的範圍擴大；
今天的緩衝區有六千五百五十公頃。
en: The World Heritage listing was extended in 2007;
its buffer zone today covers 6,550 hectares.

zh: 阿夫朗什的「手抄本博物館」，
收藏聖米歇爾山從八世紀到十五世紀的手抄本。
en: The Scriptorial museum in Avranches
holds manuscripts of Mont-Saint-Michel from the 8th to the 15th centuries.

zh: 法國大革命時，這些手抄本被送到阿夫朗什保管；
展出的書卷，每三個月更換一次。
en: During the French Revolution the manuscripts were taken to Avranches;
the volumes on show change every three months.

zh: 1172年5月21日，英王亨利二世
為了貝克特大主教遇害，在阿夫朗什公開懺悔。
en: On 21 May 1172 King Henry II of England
did penance at Avranches for the murder of Thomas Becket.

zh: 作家雨果寫過這裡的潮水，
也替這座山的保存四處奔走。
en: Victor Hugo wrote about the tides here
and campaigned to save the mount.

zh: 今天，停車場搬到兩公里半外的陸地上，
免費接駁車把遊客送到離山四百公尺的地方。
en: Today the car park is 2.5 km away on the mainland,
and free shuttles drop visitors 400 metres from the mount.

zh: 最後一段路，走在一座細長的橋上，
橋由建築師迪特瑪・費希廷格設計，2014年啟用。
en: The last stretch is a slender bridge-walkway
by the architect Dietmar Feichtinger, opened in 2014.

zh: 這道擋潮閘出自建築師呂克・韋茲曼，
2010年6月起，開放給民眾參觀。
en: The dam was designed by the architect Luc Weizmann
and opened to the public in June 2010.

zh: 海灣邊的鹽沼上放牧著羊群，
牠們的肉，就是「鹽沼羊」。
en: Sheep graze the salt marshes around the bay,
giving the salt-meadow lamb of the region.

zh: 平均每天有一千五百五十輛車來到這裡；
受保護的列級景區，有一萬六千八百多公頃。
en: On average 1,550 vehicles a day come here;
the protected landscape covers 16,825 hectares.

zh: 潮汐係數超過一百一十的大潮時，山會變回島幾個小時；
這樣的景象，曾經消失了一百三十多年。
en: When the tide coefficient tops 110 the mount is an island for a few hours,
a sight that had not been seen for more than 130 years.

zh: 朝聖者、修士、囚犯與遊客，
一千三百年來，都走向同一座山。
en: Pilgrims, monks, prisoners and visitors
have walked towards the same mount for thirteen centuries.

tagline.zh-Hant: 十萬隻冬候鳥、海豹與海豚、歐洲數一數二的鹽沼，與通布蘭島的鳥類保護區
tagline.en: 100,000 wintering waterbirds, seals and dolphins, vast salt marshes and a bird reserve on Tombelaine

zh: 1994年，聖米歇爾灣成為國際重要濕地，
登錄的範圍有四萬七千八百公頃。
en: In 1994 the bay became a Ramsar wetland of international importance,
covering 47,800 hectares.

zh: 每年冬天，這裡有十萬隻以上的水鳥；
紅腹濱鷸和黑腹濱鷸，都超過全球族群的百分之一。
en: Each winter more than 100,000 waterbirds gather here;
red knot and dunlin exceed 1% of their populations.

zh: 瀕危的水棲葦鶯在遷徙途中停靠，
每年有幾十隻被監測記錄。
en: The aquatic warbler stops here on migration,
with several dozen monitored every year.

zh: 巴利阿里鸌在換羽的季節，
也會來到這片海灣。
en: Balearic shearwaters come to the bay
during their moulting season.

zh: 北邊的通布蘭島，1985年起是鳥類保護區；
1933年，國家把整座島買了下來。
en: Tombelaine to the north has been a bird reserve since 1985;
the state bought the islet in 1933.

zh: 十一世紀，隱修者曾住在島上；
1137年，這裡建了一座小修道院。
en: In the 11th century hermits lived on the islet;
in 1137 a priory was founded here.

zh: 灣裡住著灰海豹，
港海豹也在這裡繁殖。
en: Grey seals live in the bay,
and harbour seals breed here.

zh: 灣裡也有瓶鼻海豚，
和港灣鼠海豚。
en: The bay is also home to bottlenose dolphins
and harbour porpoises.

zh: 這裡的鹽沼，是歐洲面積最大的鹽沼之一，
長著二十二種受保護的植物。
en: The bay's salt marshes are among the largest in Europe
and hold 22 protected plant species.

zh: 海蟲築成的「蜂巢礁」，
是歐洲最大的這類礁體。
en: Reefs built by honeycomb worms, called hermelles,
are the largest of their kind in Europe.

zh: 歐洲鰻和斑鰩，
也在這片灣裡生活。
en: The European eel and the brown skate
also live in the bay.

zh: 海灣北岸，卡羅勒到尚普的海崖上，
記錄到四百八十種植物。
en: On the cliffs of Carolles and Champeaux on the north shore
480 plant species have been recorded.

zh: 為了讓塞呂訥河恢復暢通，
河上兩座水力發電壩的拆除計畫已經展開。
en: To restore the Sélune's ecological continuity,
a project to level two hydroelectric dams on the river is under way.

zh: 海灣周圍大約五萬公頃，
大多是海域，都列入歐盟的「自然2000」保護網。
en: About 50,000 hectares around the bay, mostly sea,
are part of the EU's Natura 2000 network.

zh: 潮水一退一進，
把食物送給這裡數不清的鳥、魚和海豹。
en: With every ebb and flow
the tide feeds countless birds, fish and seals.

tagline.zh-Hant: 歐洲第二大的潮差、退到十公里外的海、湧潮、花崗岩，與讓山變回島的擋潮閘
tagline.en: Europe's second-largest tidal range, a sea that retreats 10 km, a tidal bore, granite and a dam

zh: 聖米歇爾灣大約五百平方公里，
潮差是歐洲第二大。
en: The bay covers about 500 square kilometres
and has the second-largest tidal range in Europe.

zh: 平均潮差十到十一公尺，
春分、秋分前後的大潮，可以到十六公尺。
en: The average range is 10 to 11 metres,
reaching 16 metres in the equinox tides.

zh: 退潮時，海水可以退到十公里外，
露出兩百多平方公里的潮間帶。
en: At low tide the sea can withdraw up to 10 km,
baring more than 200 square kilometres of flats.

zh: 雨果說，潮水來時「快得像奔馳的馬」；
實際測到的最快速度，大約每小時六點一公里。
en: Hugo said the tide comes in "at the speed of a galloping horse";
the fastest observed speed is about 6.1 km/h.

zh: 最大的潮水，會在河口形成湧潮，
沿著河道往上游推進好幾公里。
en: The highest tides can raise a tidal bore
that runs many kilometres up the rivers.

zh: 庫埃農、塞和塞呂訥三條河，流進這片海灣；
阿夫朗什就在塞河與塞呂訥河匯流的岩丘上。
en: Three rivers, the Couesnon, Sée and Sélune, flow into the bay;
Avranches stands on a rock where the Sée and Sélune meet.

zh: 阿夫朗什的海拔，從七公尺到一百一十一公尺，
鎮上看得到整片海灣和聖米歇爾山。
en: Avranches rises from 7 to 111 metres above sea level,
with a view over the whole bay to Mont-Saint-Michel.

zh: 聖米歇爾山是一塊花崗岩，
大約五億兩千五百萬年前形成。
en: Mont-Saint-Michel is a block of granite
formed about 525 million years ago.

zh: 它高九十二公尺，面積大約七公頃，
繞山一圈，大約九百六十公尺。
en: It rises 92 metres and covers about 7 hectares,
with a circumference of about 960 metres.

zh: 三公里外的通布蘭島，也是花崗岩，
高四十五公尺，長兩百五十、寬一百五十公尺。
en: Tombelaine, about 3 km away, is granite too:
45 metres high, 250 metres long and 150 wide.

zh: 每年有將近一百萬立方公尺的泥沙，
沉積在這片海灣裡。
en: Each year nearly a million cubic metres of sediment
settle in the bay.

zh: 專家警告，不採取行動的話，
到2040年，山的四周會變成一片鹽沼。
en: Experts warned that without action
the mount would be ringed by salt marsh by 2040.

zh: 2009年啟用的擋潮閘有八道閘門，
每道寬九公尺、高七點四公尺，重三十噸。
en: The dam, in service since 2009, has eight gates,
each 9 metres wide, 7.4 metres high and weighing 30 tonnes.

zh: 它可以存下一百二十萬立方公尺的海水，
再放出來，把河口的泥沙沖向大海。
en: It can hold up to 1.2 million cubic metres of seawater
and release it to flush silt from the estuary out to sea.

zh: 整個工程花了一億八千多萬歐元；
大潮的時候，聖米歇爾山又成了一座島。
en: The whole project cost about 184 million euros;
at the highest tides Mont-Saint-Michel is an island once more.
